primaryChecks.text: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
primaryChecks.previousContext: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 文脈上の地理句との関係はあり得るが固有名の明記がなく、無理に同定しない。
